title: Steertuning Policies from a Few Human Videos
abstract: arXiv:2610.18711v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current recipes for robot learning require massive amounts of robot demonstrations to obtain robust and adaptive policies. In this work, we introduce Steertuning, a system that enables robots to learn new tasks in new environments from 5 human demonstrations in under 5   Steertuning consists of two parts. (1) We pretrain a 400M-parameter diffusion policy on our egocentric human dataset, which consists of 100 hours of densely annotated random interactions. This pretraining makes Steertuning robust to background differences and enables spatial and object generalization when deployed on new tasks. (2) Given 5 demonstrations of a new task, we finetune our model for only 2 minutes (2000 training updates) and steer the policy's actions during reverse sampling using the demonstration whose observation is closest to that of the deployment environment. translated_title: 从少量人类视频中进行策略引导微调
translated_abstract: 当前的机器人学习方法需要海量的机器人演示数据才能获得鲁棒且自适应的策略。在本工作中，我们提出了Steertuning，这是一个使机器人能够仅通过5个人类演示、在5分钟内于新环境中学习新任务的系统。Steertuning由两部分组成：（1）我们在自我视角（egocentric）人类数据集上预训练了一个4亿参数的扩散策略，该数据集包含100小时的密集标注随机交互数据。这种预训练使Steertuning对背景差异具有鲁棒性，并在部署到新任务时实现空间和物体的泛化能力。（2）给定一个新任务的5个演示，我们仅需2分钟（2000次训练更新）对模型进行微调，并在反向采样过程中利用与部署环境观测最接近的演示来引导策略的动作。结合为具身形态迁移精心设计的数据处理流程，这使得机器人能够……
tldr: 提出Steertuning系统，通过在100小时人类自我视角视频上预训练扩散策略，并结合少量演示快速微调与反向采样动作引导，使机器人仅需5个人类演示即可在数分钟内学会新环境中的新任务。
en_tdlr: Steertuning enables robots to learn new tasks in new environments from just 5 human demonstrations within minutes, by pretraining a 400M-parameter diffusion policy on 100 hours of egocentric human videos and steering the policy's actions during reverse sampling.
